diagnosis: The multi-step async session transaction cancels a scheduled payout and decrements the batch counter, but never checks if payout.merchant_id == current_user.merchant_id. A malicious merchant can cancel pending payouts of rival vendors.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v1/payouts/scheduled/440182 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <rival_merchant_jwt>
